title: Word Analyzer
prompt: Implement `int word_length(const char* w)` (length, -1 for NULL), `int digit_count(const char* s)` (count of '0'..'9'), and `void title_case(char* w)` (uppercase the FIRST letter a-z in place; leave everything else).

tests.name: length
tests.hint: Delegate to strlen after the NULL check.

tests.name: title case
tests.hint: w[0] = w[0] - 'a' + 'A' when it is lowercase.

tests.name: title case guard
tests.hint: A non-letter first character is left alone.
